title: Docsite stitching: Pattern labs that bridge tokens to data widgets
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of pattern labs and migration-focused pages that explicitly connect visual tokens to interactive data widgets (buttons, tables, charts). The goal is to help eng and PM consumers perform three common tasks: 1) understand which tokens affect state/interaction for data components, 2) migrate legacy CSS class usage to the component API with minimal diffs, and 3) pick the right component variant for performance and accessibility trade-offs. Deliverables: pattern-lab pages for Tokens->Buttons, Tokens->Tables, Tokens->Charts; a migration diff generator (legacy -> new API snippets); three do/don't micro-examples per component; compact API reference tables for props and accessibility notes. Emphasis on concrete examples rather than high-level theory. Trade-offs: keep each lab under a single screen height to avoid cognitive overload, accept some duplication of code snippets across labs to preserve clarity. This ticket covers content authoring, code sample verification, basic E2E example app, and first pass of accessibility checklist integration. Engineering work for runtime or prop changes will be handled in dependent ENG tickets; this ticket focuses on docs and migration artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Pattern lab pages created for Tokens->Buttons, Tokens->Tables, Tokens->Charts and published to preview site
Each page contains at least 3 do/don't micro-examples with copy and runnable code snippets
Migration diffs (legacy CSS -> new prop-based API) generated and validated against sample repo
Compact API reference tables with aria/accessibility notes added for each component
Figma frames linked and component state screenshots embedded
Docs reviewed and approved by Engineering and PM; PR merged into docs/main
Basic a11y check (axe-core) run on example pages with no critical violations
tasks: Draft pattern lab copy and outline (tokens mapping, example flows, rationale)
Create runnable CodeSandbox examples for each lab and embed in docs
Write migration diff scripts for CSS->props and verify against sample-app
Prepare Figma frames for visual token callouts and add to doc pages
Coordinate engineering review for API examples and update code where necessary
Run accessibility smoke tests and document any findings
Open docs PR and iterate on review feedback, merge to main
decisions: Expose token mapping as a lightweight table on each lab rather than a separate reference page to reduce context switches
Provide canonical JS+TS examples; omit legacy CSS dropdowns beyond the migration diff snippets
Limit each component lab to three migration scenarios (simple upgrade, stateful interaction, high-volume data) to keep content focused
Defer deep chart API redesign recommendations to runtime-1.20 planning; docs will include migration recipes only
